outline: This course aims to give all IMBA students a sound foundation in the concepts and tools used to guide marketing decisions.  In keeping with its status as a foundation course, this course assumes no prior formal knowledge of marketing.  Because you are all consumers, however, you have a great deal of informal knowledge of marketing as a result of being on the receiving end of marketing actions.  We will try to draw on this informal knowledge as much as possible.
